answer.rationale: The new hazardous solvent introduces a chemical hazard that employees have not previously been trained about; effective hazard communication training is required when it is introduced. The training must cover the specified detection, hazard, protective-measure, program/label, and SDS topics. Because the employer uses the hazardous solvent, it must have its safety data sheet in the workplace. The portable-container labeling exception cannot be applied because the facts do not establish that the containers are intended only for the immediate use of the employee performing the transfer.
